workflows.name: adr-ingest
workflows.description: Capture a single Architectural Decision Record (ADR) into Memory.

workflows.name: bug-ingest
workflows.description: Capture a single defect report (bug) into Memory.

workflows.name: decision-log-ingest
workflows.description: Capture a single product/process decision (decision-log) into Memory.

workflows.name: service-ingest
workflows.description: Record a single external service (account, credential by reference, listing, setting, domain, handle) into Memory.

workflows.name: sw-life-cycle
workflows.description: Full software life cycle for WingFoil UI: from WingFoil initialisation and product inception, through technical specification downcast, iterative per-release delivery, to end-of-life.
